blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 40-year-old businessman was shot dead by two motorcycle-riding gunmen in Lumban, Laguna, on Saturday afternoon, Nov. 7, police said. In a report on Sunday, the Police Regional Office 4-A said the victim was standing in front of his water refilling station along Rizal Street in Barangay Primera Parang at 1:40 p.m. when the suspects pulled up. According to investigators, the back rider pulled out a firearm and shot the businessman. The suspects immediately fled after the shooting. Police are conducting further investigation to establish the motive behind the attack and to identify and arrest the suspects.... Keep on reading: Laguna businessman shot dead
